question_text: Shop uses a fixed-capacity Python list self.items, with self.used occupied entries at the front and None afterwards. Construct add_item(self, item). Add the same object only if absent and capacity remains; otherwise print Full or Already present. Use object identity, not equal names.
adaptation_rationale: Retains fixed capacity/membership branching; identity rule prevents sourceMSname-equality short cut in correctly merging distinct objects.
